xmldoc.short_description: Return whole calendar months between two dates.

param_input_item.param_description: Two datetime or date-compatible inputs with matching sizes or scalar expansion.

param_output_item.param_description: A double array of whole month counts.

description.p: Return whole calendar months between two dates.
The result counts completed calendar months and adjusts when the second day-of-month is before the first.
Array-valued inputs keep their data shape when the operation supports arrays. Scalar operands are expanded where the implementation defines scalar expansion.
